description: SessionStart board-context injection (KAIROS-A-0014): emits the repo's .claude/kairos.local.md wiring as additionalContext and instructs the agent to pull live board state via the authenticated kairos MCP tools. Hooks hold no credentials (tokens live with the MCP client); offline degrades to a note. Silent no-op when the repo is not bootstrapped. Stop: the Ralph loop (COLLIERY-T-1861) blocks the stop and gives the next step while a loop of this session is active (state in ~/.claude/kairos-ralph/<session_id>.json); no loop -> silent no-op. SessionStart `compact` + PostToolUse on the kairos item tools (COLLIERY-T-1862): after a compaction, active_work.py gives the agent its Active tasks, their initiatives and next steps, and the Ralph loop, from a local record per session (~/.claude/kairos-work/<session_id>.json); no Kairos read, no credentials. SessionStart `*` + PostToolUse on Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit (COLLIERY-T-1855): index_update.py starts `kairos index update --link-only` as a detached background job (no model, COLLIERY-T-2529; KAIROS_INDEX_SUMMARIZE=1 runs the model; no wait; skipped when `kairos` is not on PATH or the checkout has no .claude/kairos.local.md), tells the agent to use the code tools of the kairos-code MCP server before it reads files, and keeps a list of edited source files that the background job logs and clears after a successful update (state and log in ~/.claude/kairos-index/<name>-<hash>/).
